info.title: ProofRail MCP Verification & Release Certification
info.description: Discover, preflight, verify, and certify public MCP servers before deployment or trust. ProofRail checks MCP reachability, protocol negotiation, tools/list, tool schemas, transport, and authentication behavior; full x402-paid certification returns a deterministic PASS, FAIL, or PARTIAL evidence receipt.
info.x-guidance: Use /api/radar to discover public MCP endpoints from ProofRail's autonomous index; over MCP, call find_mcp_servers for task-oriented discovery or mcp_radar_snapshot for advanced filtering. Search by query and filter or sort by outcome, connection, source, tool name, tool count, observation count, pass rate, stability, freshness, or relevance. Use /api/radar/changes or mcp_radar_changes to inspect changes between scans. Before deploying, upgrading, or trusting a specific MCP server, call /api/preflight over HTTP or mcp_release_preflight over MCP; it is free and needs no payment. Use /api/purchase for the buying guide. Use /api/certify or mcp_release_certify with required_tools and optional baseline_schema_hashes for paid deployment contract checks, ALLOW/BLOCK/REVIEW decisions, and the deterministic evidence receipt; paid results include a public verification_url for the settled receipt. Full certification payment uses Base mainnet USDC.
